tecla.setup_colab module¶

Full plug-and-play setup utility for TECLA in Google Colab.

Features: - User selects which languages to install (spaCy models) - Dependencies auto-installed - NLTK stopwords auto-downloaded - Cleans cached modules - TECLA becomes importable immediately

tecla.setup_colab.setup_tecla(path='/content/TECLA_v2', languages=['es', 'en'])[fuente]¶

Run full TECLA setup in Google Colab.

Parameters: - path (str): Path to TECLA repo - languages (list or «all»): spaCy languages to install
